Win-loss review — 2026-11
43% won by count (3 of 7), 44% by value; pattern: outbound lost 4 of 4 and every loss ran past 50 days

## Won
| Account | Value | Source | Days | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Yew | 24000 | referral | 30 | fit |
| Ash | 18000 | inbound | 35 | fit |
| Fir | 9000 | inbound | 28 | price ok |

## Lost
| Account | Value | Source | Days | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Oak | 30000 | outbound | 60 | price |
| Pine | 12000 | outbound | 72 | no decision |
| Teak | 15000 | outbound | 55 | competitor |
| Maple | 8000 | outbound | 51 | price |

## Patterns
- By source: outbound lost 4 of 4; inbound and referral won 3 of 3.
- By length: every loss ran over 50 days; every win closed under 36.

## Do differently
- Qualify outbound harder before Proposal sent; add a 45-day check that asks for a decision date.

## Too few to say
- By reason: price 2, no decision 1, competitor 1 — no reason reaches three.
